why: v53-v56: no s0 variant meets the strict orbital criterion, and every stalled orbital lies in a set ({1s,2s}; even 3p-6p, 4f-5f; odd 3s-6s, 3d-5d) whose rotations leave the s0 CSF space of each J block, hence every EOL eigenvalue and state, unchanged. If so the strict criterion is ill-posed for s0 and the native energy stop is physically sufficient; if not, s0 is genuinely unconverged. Measure it.
scope: Per parity, s0 (Li MCDHF MR, 0 excitations, 45 even / 36 odd EOL targets, standard weights, all orbitals varied and spectroscopic, method 3 for every orbital via the v56 non-default path, 500 cycles) with the standard rmcdhf, from two starts: A Thomas-Fermi then screened hydrogenic (v53); B screened hydrogenic for all. jj2lsj families, energies, native residuals; rbiotransform + rtransition E1 for A and for B.
verdict_rule: INVARIANCE_SUPPORTED if both parities x both starts stop natively with the targeted families, every orbital with final residual > ACCY lies in a predicted set, every target eigenvalue agrees A vs B within 5e-7 Hartree, and every E1 pair with S >= 1e-6 au agrees A vs B within 1e-3 relative in both gauges. INVARIANCE_REFUTED if all four runs converge with families but an agreement test fails. INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. Tolerances: 5e-7 Ha is ~100x the native relative energy stop (0.001*ACCY*|E|); 1e-3 in S is far below the gauge differences under study (percent level).
guards: Fresh directory; prlimit --as=12 GiB; budgets as v53; disk guard 40 GiB. A clean iteration-limit stop or the native IMPROV stop is a measured run outcome (verdict INCONCLUSIVE); any other refusal, a prompt mismatch, the s0 lists differing from v56, or a missing table is FAILED_RETAINED.
consequence: SUPPORTED -> v58 runs the layers with the native energy stop for s0 and records strict residuals per orbital, keeping the strict criterion for the non-redundant correlation orbitals of each layer. REFUTED/INCONCLUSIVE -> sequential spectroscopic optimisation (each Rydberg orbital on its own series) is declared next.
evidence: Receipt and every native file archived.
